description: Cross-provider uptime leaderboard ranked by uptime % DESC, computed from minute-resolution counters (~720 samples per provider per day). days 1 to 7 is free; days 8 to 90 costs 5 credits ($0.10), adding incident_count and mttr_minutes (mean time to recover) per provider over the longer window. tier='full' uses the paid tier at any window. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

days.description: Window length in days (1 to 90, default 7). 1 to 7 free; 8 to 90 costs 5 credits.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

tier.description: Optional. 'full' uses the paid tier even for a window of 7 days or less (adds incident_count and mttr_minutes per provider). Omit for the default split: days 1 to 7 free, 8 to 90 paid.

name: status_leaderboard
